title: FBI Photo B3
doc_notes: This document is an FBI submission to AARO containing a single infrared-style photograph with redactions and an incorrect system timestamp.

incidents.summary: A grainy monochrome image captured by a U.S. military system showing a small, dark, circular object near a crosshair reticle.
incidents.explanation: The operator reported that they were unable to positively identify the UAP.
incidents.quote: A small, dark, circular object is visible just to the right of the center of the reticle.
